title: The art of doing nothing
summary: What happens when we stop filling every silence and let stillness speak for itself.

blocks.text: When you stop reaching for an outcome, the mind has room to tell the truth. You don't lose time—you meet it.
Sit comfortably. Inhale. Exhale. Let the next thought pass like a visitor who doesn't need a conversation. When you drift, return gently—without punishment.
